target: Hari ini cuacanya cerah sekali.
english: The weather today is really clear.

target: Kalau hujan, saya naik taksi ke kantor.
english: If it rains, I take a taxi to the office.
grammar: kalau starts an if-clause; no 'then' word needed after the comma: Kalau hujan, saya naik taksi.

target: Di luar sedang hujan deras.
english: It is raining heavily outside.

target: Jangan lupa bawa payung hari ini.
english: Don't forget to bring an umbrella today.
grammar: Jangan lupa + verb = don't forget to: Jangan lupa bawa payung.

target: Langit mendung, mungkin sebentar lagi hujan.
english: The sky is overcast, maybe it will rain soon.

target: Musim hujan di Jakarta mulai bulan November.
english: The rainy season in Jakarta starts in November.

target: Saya tidak suka udara panas dan lembap.
english: I don't like hot and humid air.

target: Cuaca di Bandung lebih sejuk daripada di Jakarta.
english: The weather in Bandung is cooler than in Jakarta.
grammar: lebih + adjective + daripada compares: lebih sejuk daripada Jakarta = cooler than Jakarta.

target: Apakah besok akan hujan lagi?
english: Will it rain again tomorrow?

target: Kalau cuaca cerah, kami pergi ke pantai.
english: If the weather is clear, we go to the beach.

target: Angin bertiup kencang sekali malam ini.
english: The wind is blowing very strongly tonight.

target: Jalan di depan rumah kami banjir lagi.
english: The street in front of our house is flooded again.

target: Musim kemarau biasanya mulai bulan Mei.
english: The dry season usually starts in May.
grammar: musim = season. Indonesia has two: musim hujan (rainy) and musim kemarau (dry).

target: Hari ini panas sekali, sampai tiga puluh lima derajat.
english: It is very hot today, up to thirty-five degrees.

target: Saya kehujanan waktu pulang dari pasar tadi.
english: I got caught in the rain coming home from the market earlier.
grammar: ke-…-an around a noun = affected by it: kehujanan = caught in the rain.

target: Bawa jas hujan kalau naik motor hari ini.
english: Bring a raincoat if you ride a motorbike today.

target: Udara pagi di gunung dingin dan segar.
english: The morning air in the mountains is cold and fresh.

target: Kalau banjir, anak-anak tidak pergi ke sekolah.
english: If there is a flood, the children don't go to school.

target: Cuaca hari ini bagus untuk jalan-jalan.
english: Today's weather is good for going out for a stroll.
grammar: Doubling a verb relaxes it: jalan-jalan = to stroll, go out (not just 'walk').

target: Sudah tiga hari hujan tidak berhenti.
english: It has been raining nonstop for three days.

target: Di musim kemarau, sungai kecil itu kering.
english: In the dry season, that small river is dry.

target: Besok kami mendaki gunung kalau tidak hujan.
english: Tomorrow we will climb the mountain if it doesn't rain.

target: Baju saya basah karena hujan tadi sore.
english: My clothes are wet because of the rain this afternoon.

target: Jemur pakaian di luar, hari ini panas.
english: Hang the laundry outside, it is hot today.

target: Suhu di sini turun waktu malam hari.
english: The temperature here drops at night.

target: Kata ramalan cuaca, besok akan cerah.
english: According to the weather forecast, tomorrow will be clear.
grammar: kata + source = 'according to': Kata ramalan cuaca, besok cerah.

target: Saya suka duduk di teras waktu hujan.
english: I like sitting on the terrace when it rains.

target: Kalau panas begini, saya minum es teh.
english: When it is hot like this, I drink iced tea.
grammar: begini = 'like this': panas begini = hot like this.

target: Musim dingin di Jepang mulai bulan Desember.
english: Winter in Japan starts in December.

target: Awan hitam itu tanda hujan akan turun.
english: Those black clouds are a sign rain is coming.

target: Kami berteduh di halte sampai hujan berhenti.
english: We took shelter at the bus stop until the rain stopped.

target: Jalanan licin, hati-hati kalau naik motor.
english: The roads are slippery, be careful if you ride a motorbike.

target: Tahun ini ada banjir besar di kota kami.
english: This year there was a big flood in our city.

target: Anak saya senang main hujan di halaman.
english: My child loves playing in the rain in the yard.

target: Pakai topi, matahari siang ini terik sekali.
english: Wear a hat, the midday sun is really scorching.

target: Kalau mendung begini, jangan jemur pakaian dulu.
english: When it is overcast like this, don't hang out the laundry yet.
grammar: dulu after a command = 'for now / yet': Jangan jemur dulu = don't hang it out yet.

target: Cuaca di pantai sangat panas siang tadi.
english: The weather at the beach was very hot this afternoon.

target: Hujan gerimis tidak apa-apa, kita tetap jalan.
english: A little drizzle is fine, we are still going.
grammar: tidak apa-apa = 'it's okay, no problem' — the everyday reassurance phrase.

target: Setelah hujan, udara jadi sejuk dan bersih.
english: After the rain, the air becomes cool and clean.
grammar: jadi before an adjective = 'becomes': udara jadi sejuk = the air turns cool.

target: Banjir kemarin masuk sampai ke dalam rumah.
english: Yesterday's flood came all the way into the house.

target: Saya selalu cek ramalan cuaca sebelum berangkat.
english: I always check the weather forecast before leaving.

target: Kalau musim hujan, bawa payung ke mana-mana.
english: In the rainy season, take an umbrella everywhere.
grammar: Doubled mana = 'everywhere': ke mana-mana (to everywhere), di mana-mana (everywhere).

target: Angin laut sore hari enak sekali di sini.
english: The sea breeze in the late afternoon is really pleasant here.

target: Kantor kami tutup karena banjir besar hari ini.
english: Our office is closed because of the big flood today.

target: Jangan berenang di laut kalau ombak besar.
english: Don't swim in the sea when the waves are big.

target: Kemarin hujan es turun di kota Bandung.
english: Yesterday hail fell in the city of Bandung.
grammar: hujan + noun names the rain type: hujan es = hail, hujan deras = heavy rain.

target: Cuaca panas membuat saya cepat lelah.
english: Hot weather makes me tired quickly.

target: Kalau dingin, ibu membuat teh jahe hangat.
english: When it is cold, Mom makes warm ginger tea.

target: Musim hujan tahun ini datang lebih awal.
english: This year's rainy season came earlier.

target: Sepatu saya kotor karena jalan masih basah.
english: My shoes are dirty because the road is still wet.

target: Apa hobi kamu di waktu luang?
english: What is your hobby in your free time?
grammar: waktu luang = free time: di waktu luang = in your free time.

target: Saya suka membaca novel sebelum tidur.
english: I like reading novels before sleeping.
grammar: suka + verb = like doing something: suka membaca = like reading.

target: Setiap akhir pekan kami bermain sepak bola.
english: Every weekend we play soccer.
grammar: akhir pekan = weekend ('end of week'): setiap akhir pekan = every weekend.

target: Kakak saya biasanya berenang setiap hari Minggu.
english: My older sibling usually swims every Sunday.
grammar: biasanya (usually) sits before the verb: Dia biasanya berenang hari Minggu.

target: Kadang-kadang saya menonton film di bioskop.
english: Sometimes I watch movies at the cinema.
grammar: kadang-kadang = sometimes: Kadang-kadang saya menonton film.

target: Ayah suka memancing di sungai dekat rumah.
english: Dad likes fishing in the river near the house.

target: Kami sekeluarga suka memasak bersama hari Minggu.
english: Our whole family likes cooking together on Sundays.
grammar: se- + noun = one whole unit: sekeluarga = the whole family, sekelas = the whole class.

target: Saya belajar main gitar dari video di internet.
english: I am learning to play guitar from videos on the internet.

target: Teman kantor saya suka bersepeda ke mana-mana.
english: My office friend likes cycling everywhere.

target: Musik apa yang biasanya kamu dengarkan?
english: What music do you usually listen to?
grammar: yang links a question word to its verb: Musik apa yang kamu suka? = what music do you like?

target: Setiap pagi dia lari di taman kota.
english: Every morning he runs in the city park.

target: Hobi saya menggambar wajah orang di kereta.
english: My hobby is drawing people's faces on the train.

target: Akhir pekan ini kami mau menonton konser musik.
english: This weekend we want to watch a music concert.

target: Saya suka memasak makanan Korea di rumah.
english: I like cooking Korean food at home.

target: Dia bisa bermain piano sejak kecil.
english: She has been able to play the piano since she was little.
grammar: sejak = since: sejak kecil = since childhood, sejak tadi = for a while now.

target: Kami biasanya jalan-jalan ke mal hari Sabtu.
english: We usually go out to the mall on Saturdays.

target: Suami saya suka menanam sayur di kebun kecil.
english: My husband likes growing vegetables in a small garden.

target: Setelah kerja, saya berolahraga di gym dekat kantor.
english: After work, I exercise at the gym near the office.

target: Film Indonesia sekarang bagus-bagus sekali.
english: Indonesian films these days are all really good.
grammar: Doubling an adjective spreads it over many items: bagus-bagus = all (of them) good.

target: Anak saya suka menyanyi lagu anak-anak.
english: My child likes singing children's songs.

target: Saya membaca berita di ponsel setiap pagi.
english: I read the news on my phone every morning.

target: Kadang-kadang kami bermain kartu sampai malam.
english: Sometimes we play cards until late at night.

target: Olahraga apa yang paling kamu suka?
english: What sport do you like the most?
grammar: paling = the most: paling suka = like most, paling bagus = the best.

target: Di waktu luang, dia menulis cerita pendek.
english: In her free time, she writes short stories.

target: Kami menonton pertandingan bola di rumah teman.
english: We watch the football match at a friend's house.

target: Saya baru mulai belajar memasak masakan Padang.
english: I just started learning to cook Padang cuisine.
grammar: baru before a verb = just (recently): baru mulai = just started.

target: Setiap sore anak-anak bermain layang-layang di lapangan.
english: Every afternoon the children fly kites on the field.

target: Ibu saya suka menari tarian tradisional Bali.
english: My mother likes dancing traditional Balinese dances.

target: Akhir pekan lalu kami mendaki gunung bersama.
english: Last weekend we hiked a mountain together.

target: Saya lebih suka membaca buku daripada menonton televisi.
english: I prefer reading books to watching television.
grammar: lebih suka X daripada Y = prefer X to Y: lebih suka membaca daripada menonton.

target: Dia mengambil foto pemandangan waktu jalan-jalan.
english: He takes photos of scenery while traveling around.

target: Kolam renang dekat rumah buka sampai jam sembilan.
english: The swimming pool near the house is open until nine o'clock.

target: Teman saya suka main catur setelah makan siang.
english: My friend likes playing chess after lunch.

target: Biasanya saya dengarkan musik waktu membersihkan rumah.
english: I usually listen to music while cleaning the house.

target: Apa yang biasanya kamu lakukan hari Minggu?
english: What do you usually do on Sundays?

target: Kami suka mencoba kafe baru setiap bulan.
english: We like trying a new cafe every month.

target: Dia berlatih badminton dua kali seminggu.
english: He practices badminton twice a week.
grammar: kali counts times: dua kali seminggu = twice a week, sekali = once.

target: Saya suka masak, tapi tidak suka cuci piring.
english: I like cooking, but I don't like washing dishes.
grammar: In conversation the meN- prefix often drops: memasak → masak, mencuci → cuci.

target: Setiap malam Jumat kami berkumpul dan bernyanyi bersama.
english: Every Friday night we get together and sing.

target: Menonton film horor bukan hobi saya.
english: Watching horror films is not my hobby.
grammar: bukan negates nouns, tidak negates verbs: bukan hobi saya = not my hobby.

target: Dia belajar bahasa Jepang sebagai hobi baru.
english: She is learning Japanese as a new hobby.

target: Kami main musik bersama di garasi setiap Sabtu.
english: We play music together in the garage every Saturday.

target: Saya suka membuat kue untuk teman kantor.
english: I like making cakes for my office friends.

target: Kapan kamu biasanya punya waktu luang?
english: When do you usually have free time?

target: Akhir pekan depan ada festival musik di pantai.
english: Next weekend there is a music festival at the beach.
grammar: depan after a time word = next: akhir pekan depan = next weekend, bulan depan = next month.

target: Dia jarang menonton televisi, lebih suka membaca.
english: He rarely watches television, he prefers reading.
grammar: jarang = rarely, before the verb: Dia jarang menonton televisi.

target: Bermain game di ponsel itu hobi anak muda sekarang.
english: Playing games on the phone is young people's hobby now.

target: Saya menulis catatan perjalanan setiap kali liburan.
english: I write travel notes every time I go on vacation.

target: Kadang-kadang kami masak sate di halaman belakang.
english: Sometimes we grill satay in the backyard.

target: Hobi baru saya memotret burung di taman.
english: My new hobby is photographing birds in the park.
